slot_note: Architecture 6 in a fresh world (architectures 1 to 5 spent, lineage). Its first wording (rotation read over the window's rotation places) died at the draw probes; the drawn design passed two call-only probes on 2026-10-26 and waited for the guard window before filing.
niche: a national blood donor charity choosing which of three draft television schedules for a four-week April 2027 youth campaign puts its film before the most adults aged 18 to 34 three or more times, each schedule replayed second by second on the audience panel's March 2026 reference weeks, where the channels' traffic placed oversold prime-time rotation bookings in daytime breaks
analyst_test: A strong analyst who converts the panel's UTC statements to the as-run log's local clock, maps the renamed channel, drops guests and time-shifted viewing, weights members by their 28-day weight and replays each schedule spot by spot reads each prime-time rotation spot over the rotation places the as-run log shows inside prime time that day, and buys schedule B at 31.8 per cent three-plus reach against A's 26.6.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each schedule's three-plus reach among adults 18 to 34, built from the panel's person-level live viewing at the seconds each spot would air, the field's spot-level reach and frequency; a rotation spot's place is the channel's traffic decision, so where it would air is the airing record of the bookings sold on the same terms, which in sold-out prime includes the daytime places the bookings were moved to. With another field's nouns there is no commercial break, no person-level viewing of a place and no traffic system that places run-of-station bookings outside their window.
layer2_pattern: own:rotation spots read over where the same-terms bookings aired, moved bookings included, not over the window's rotation places

spine.entity: one row is one continuous spell of one person in a panel home present before one channel

driver: The decisive quantity is where an item sold without a fixed slot would have landed, and the record of where such items landed shows only the ones that landed inside the slot they were sold for as belonging to it; joining the sales record to the landing record finds that a third were placed elsewhere, in slots worth a fraction as much, so reading the item over the in-slot landings alone credits it with value it would not have had and reverses the choice.
driver_concrete: Each 2027 prime-time rotation spot in schedule B is read at the places where that reference day's prime-time rotation bookings on the same channel actually aired, found by joining the sales houses' bookings to the as-run log on the booking number, so the third of them (1,521 of 4,545) the channels' traffic placed in daytime breaks count at their daytime audiences, and B falls from 31.8 to 22.1 per cent three-plus reach, below A's 26.6.
stump: A competent analyst replays the three schedules on the reference weeks, reads each rotation spot over the rotation places the as-run log shows in prime time that day and buys schedule B at 31.8 per cent three-plus reach against A's 26.6; the step that lands them there is taking the prime-time rotation places as where a prime-time rotation spot airs, when the bookings joined to the as-run log show the channels placed 1,521 of 4,545 (33.5 per cent) in daytime breaks.

differentiation.task139: task139 reads a randomised intervention per assigned unit because the arm changes which units become costly cases; this build reads a schedule's spot where the bookings sold on its terms aired, because the airing record shows only the bookings the channel kept in the window they were sold for.
differentiation.task182: task182 corrects a duration distribution sampled in proportion to length; here every booking airs once and the airing record is complete, and the step is joining each airing to the sale that defines what a 2027 spot would replay.
differentiation.task265: task265 handles left truncation, earlier starters entering the record only if event-free; here nothing is truncated in time, the moved bookings are all in the record at other hours, and the step is attributing each airing to the window it was sold for.
differentiation.task452: task452 reweights reference observations by inclusion probabilities from a revised classification; here there is no sampling design, a complete census of airings and sales, and the step is the join that says which airings a prime-time sale produced.
differentiation.task270: architecture 1 corrected correlations for selection on a rank of two measures; this architecture reads a 2027 spot's place from the 2026 bookings sold on its terms, where the window's airings are the bookings the channel kept there.

lineage.niche: the predictive validity of a civil-service police entry examination's components across the candidate pool, estimated from an academy outcome that exists only for the candidates appointed in rank order of two of the components
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how strongly each of several measures predicts an outcome across a whole pool when the outcome exists only for the members picked from the pool in rank order of a weighted sum of two of the measures; the correlations among those picked understate every measure, and correcting each measure as if it alone had picked them leaves the two that formed the sum understated, so only a correction that models the pick on the sum, with the measures' spread across the whole pool, restores which measures predict best.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each examination component's correlation with the police academy's final average across everyone who sat the 2024 and 2025 examinations, recovered from the appointees' grades by the multivariate correction on the written test, the oral board, the veterans' credit and the physical ability test's points the appointments were made on; the appointees' own correlations and a per-component Case II correction both leave the written test and the oral board looking weaker than they are and keep the work style inventory.
lineage.stump: A competent solver correlates each component with the academy final average among the appointees, or corrects each correlation separately by Case II, and keeps the written test and the work style inventory, because the appointments were made in rank order of the written test and oral board composite, which restricted those two (and the oral board most, beside the written test it was ranked with) far more than the per-component spreads show.
lineage.answer: The 2027 entry examination should keep the written test and the oral board.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-19 at stage 4 (Gate F): both isolated scored readers landed the call, the order and the first component below; reader 1 applied the multivariate correction for selection on the variables the appointments were ranked on (Lawley) from the filed rules and the plan's pool, reader 2 the same correction; reader 1 also landed all five costs (5 of 14 ask figures), reader 2 all 14; the judge DETERMINISTIC, APPROVE. A filed selection rule plus a filed population of appointees and non-appointees hands a strong reader the textbook correction.

lineage.niche: a no-claims step scale makes an at-fault claim cost a policyholder future premium that depends on the step they stand on, so drivers on the middle steps pay small damage themselves; the frequency a region will show once the 2027 wording removes that cost is recovered from the claims nobody absorbs and the size distribution of the policyholders for whom a claim already costs nothing
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how often each group's members will report an event once reporting costs them nothing, when today each member absorbs events smaller than what reporting would cost them and that cost rises and falls with their position on a scale, so the reported count understates most the groups whose members stand where reporting costs most; counting only the events too large for anyone to absorb, scaled by how common events that large are among members for whom reporting already costs nothing, recovers it, while a group that buys out the cost is self-selected and gives the size of events, not their rate.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each region's claims per 100 vehicle-years under the 2027 protected wording, recovered step by step from the at-fault claims above the size no policyholder absorbs, scaled by the share of claims that large among step-0 policyholders and Step Protection holders, plus the not-at-fault claims everyone already makes; the reported frequency and a lift taken from the Step Protection holders' frequency on steps 6 to 9 leave the middle-step regions understated.
lineage.stump: A competent solver ranks the regions by their 2024 and 2025 reported claim frequency (or lifts steps 6 to 9 by the Step Protection holders' frequency) and files band C as South East, West Midlands and Yorkshire and the Humber, South East in place of North West, because North West's policyholders stand mostly on the middle steps with the book's highest premiums, where a claim costs the most premium over the climb back, and pay small at-fault damage themselves, so North West reports the smallest share of its accidents while South East, on the top steps and under Step Protection, reports nearly all of its own.
lineage.answer: Band C of the 2027 rating basis holds North West, West Midlands and Yorkshire and the Humber; South East is the first region below.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-19 at stage 4 (Gate F): reader 6 of six isolated scored readers took the claims above 2,500 pounds as fully reported and scaled them by the protected policies' share above that size, landing the call and the first region below; readers 1 to 5 filed the reported or uplifted band; reader 5 took all 32 ask figures. Section 2.1's counterfactual wording says a correction is owed, and claim sizes by step show where the scale stops mattering, so the recovery is reachable for a strong reader.

lineage.answer: The Research Committee should name Quarndale and Thurlwick as the recruiting sites for ARV-1102.
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how fast each group's members lose a latent ability, read from repeated tests whose second sitting is lifted by the member having sat the test before; a slope through every sitting flattens most for the groups whose members have sat it only a few times, so those groups look slower than they are, and only separating the one-time gain of the second sitting from the trend puts the groups in their true order.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each memory clinic's average decline in ACE-III points a year over 2022 to September 2026, net of the change the test itself produces, which is the gain a patient's second completed sitting of their whole record carries, estimated within patients across all clinics; sized on the period's sittings alone it is diluted by the patients first assessed before 2022, and a slope through every sitting, per patient or in a random-slopes model, keeps it in, so both leave Quarndale, nearly all of whose patients have sat the test twice, outside the pair and name Thurlwick and Penwardine.
lineage.niche: the rate at which memory clinic patients' cognition declines, read from repeated ACE-III sittings whose second completed sitting is lifted by the patient having sat the test before, compared across clinics whose patients have sat it a median of two to five times because the clinics opened between 2014 and 2024
lineage.stump: A competent solver who reads the paper's 3.1 sizes the change the test itself produces on the period's sittings, each patient's first completed sitting from 2022 taken as their first (1.24 points), and files Thurlwick and Penwardine as the two fastest-declining clinics, Penwardine in place of Quarndale, because the gain belongs to each patient's whole record: patients first assessed before 2022 carry it through every sitting in the period, which dilutes a step read inside the period to half its size, while Quarndale, opened in April 2024 with nearly all of its patients at two sittings, stays sixth. Only the gain estimated over each patient's whole record, within patients (2.63), netted from every patient's slope puts Quarndale in the pair.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-19 at stage 4 round 2 (Gate F): round 1 readers missed with the outcome unfiled and the judge sent it back; filing it (a change the test itself produces is not part of the rate) named the practice effect, and both round 2 readers estimated it within patients and landed the pair

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is whether a part of a composite score estimates a unit's true standing on that part more accurately than the whole composite does; the part's own measurement error sits inside the composite, so taking the composite's agreement with the part as agreement between two separate measures credits the composite with the part's own error and finds the composite better for parts where it is not.
lineage.driver_concrete: A content-area score is printed in 2027 only where its reliability exceeds the share of the area's true-score variance the total score predicts, with the total's covariance with the true area score taken as its covariance with the observed area score less the area's own error variance.
lineage.layer2_pattern: own:a part's value beside a total that contains it, with the part's own error inside the total
lineage.niche: a fitness professional certification board deciding which of its seven content-area scores to print on 2027 candidate score reports, from the 2026 attempts' item responses
lineage.stump: A competent analyst disattenuates each area's correlation with the total for the area's unreliability as though the two were separate tests, finds the total predicts the largest area's true score better than that area's own score does, and prints only the most distinct areas; the step that lands them there is treating the total as a separate measure when the area's items, and their errors, are part of it.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-26 at the draw probes: probes p270a and p270b, call-only Sonnet readers on prototypes of 26,000 attempts, computed Haberman's PRMSE with the part-whole correction (and, with case-study sets added, reliability over the case sets) and printed the golden three each time; the policy's criterion is Haberman's own question

lineage.niche: a second-hand fashion marketplace app choosing which two-week metric reads every 2027 onboarding experiment as its proxy for six-month retention, judged on the platform's per-arm scorecards for about 220 onboarding experiments run since 2024, with user-level data only for the 2025 global holdout
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how closely two quantities' true changes move together across many trials, when each trial measures both changes on the same sample of members, so the two estimates' errors move together wherever the quantities are correlated member by member; the raw correlation of the estimates counts that shared error as shared change and favours the quantity most like the outcome member by member rather than change by change.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each candidate's effects across the 2024 to 2026 onboarding experiments are correlated with the experiments' six-month retention effects after each experiment's sampling covariance between the candidate and retention (the holdout panel's user-level correlation times the arms' standard deviations over their users) is taken out of the cross-experiment covariance and each sampling variance out of the variances; first purchase within 14 days leads.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst correlates the experiments' scorecard effects on each candidate with their six-month retention effects, disattenuates for the sampling error in each, and adopts sessions in days 1 to 14; the step that lands them there is treating each experiment's two sampling errors as independent when both effects are measured on the same users, so the shared error counts as shared change for the metrics most like retention user by user.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-26 at stage 4 round 2 (Gate F): with 2.3 filing that the correlation is between the effects themselves, both isolated readers took the full sampling-covariance correction and landed first purchase; round 1's readers had missed with the estimand unfiled and the judge held the raw correlation open
